message: フリーダム・サリーちゃん
The moment I arrived to visit Asukai Shrine, I heard Shio-chan's loud voice.
Though she claims to be composed, she is clearly flustered. In contrast, Sally-chan innocently tilts her head.

name: Sally
message: 「You see, Shio-chi says she doesn't own a bra!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--!! Does that mean, no way... you aren't wearing--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... She's probably wrapping herself in a sarashi or something.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well... you do have club activities, after all. And you probably sweat a lot...」

name: Shio
message: 「Please refrain from analyzing it so calmly...」

name: Sally
message: 「H~~mm. I think bras just get in the way, though~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, isn't going no-bra and no-panties standard for shrine maidens?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you saying?! Even if she's a shrine maiden...」

name: Sally
message: 「I see. In that case, I guess it can't be helped that a shrine maiden like Shio-chi goes commando with no bra and no panties.」

name: Shio
message: 「That is why I said I am not!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Which means I'm a shrine maiden tooo!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Didn't Flat-Chest used to dream of having a sexy body too?」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, I don't wanna live tied down by anything, you know.」

name: Sally
message: 「Besides, I'm still right in the middle of my growth spurt! Once I'm a little more grown up, I'm gonna be all boing-boing and bouncy-bouncy.」

name: Shio
message: 「Are you saying, Sally-dono, that even if you become like that, you still would not wear any undergarments.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan being super bouncy and not wearing any underwear at all, huh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Time for your usual nosebleed?」
